snippet.title: Dawn of Irkalla - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
GreenMindMedia presents Veilwalkers. Veilwalkers is a single player or coop survival, horror, dungeon exploration game. Loot treasure and outsmart monsters while finding secret artifacts for a secret government agency. Build your deck of cards and use items to increase your chances of survival in a race against time. Can you escape the dungeon alive?

Veilwalkers is coming in late 2025 to Steam on PC
